note: Single source of truth for forbidden notification copy. Consumed at CI time by scripts/check-notification-copy-safety.mjs (source scan) and at runtime by src/lib/notifications/copy-safety.ts (creation-boundary enforcement). Governance non-negotiable: notification hooks must not promise profit, induce panic, or push reckless trading behavior. Patterns are compiled case-insensitive.

rules.reason: notification copy must not promise or guarantee profit
notification copy must not induce panic or fear of missing out
notification copy must not push buy/sell signals
notification copy must not push reckless / gambling trading behavior
